I've attached our onboarding form (AcmeSoft_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf) — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

- Invoice issuer: Redwood Inference EU LTD — VAT: IE1234567RT (we will include the full VAT number on the invoice).

A few items & next steps:
1) Supplier authorization: we need a signed supplier authorization from AcmeSoft that permits e-invoice ingestion and confirms where to send copies. To speed things up we've prepared a short supplier authorization template (redwood_supplier_authorization.docx). If you can sign and return, we can enable portal delivery immediately. I can send a DocuSign link if your legal team prefers that.
2) VAT/Place of supply: from what you've sent, it looks like AcmeSoft is registered in PT. If you intend to apply reverse-charge, please confirm the tax treatment in writing and provide your VAT registration number so we can tag invoices accordingly.
3) PO/Remit: we'll include PO numbers on every invoice when supplied. For remit-to, please confirm the exact IBAN and beneficiary name.

If you prefer, I can open a short GoToMeeting with our billing ops to walk through the portal onboarding.

Best regards,
